Nike Air Liquid Max Fragment Black, releasing Friday April 3rd, was a both a sneaker and colorway I was not expecting to like, but for some reason I’m absolutely loving them both 🤧 Even though the colorway is very basic, they made it look very clean and futuristic looking, but that may be more because of the silhouette as opposed to a design choice by Fragment. I was not feeling this silhouette at all when they debuted the Nike Air Liquid Max Black Green Apple on Air Max Day this year, but the more pictures I see, the more that I like the colorway again because of that futuristic look, but also because I can see the insane potential when it comes to unique looking colorways. The silhouette in general is quite out my comfort zone, being a new air max which I’m usually not fond of, a bulky looking sneaker which I’m usually not fond of, and having a bubble style bottom which I’m also not usually fond of. All in all, I’m very excited to see what Nike is going to give us with this silhouette and I look forward to maybe adding this silhouette into my collection at some point down the line, assuming they are at least somewhat comfortable 👀 Are you going after these sneakers or are you skipping out?
